name: Teysa Karlov
description: Teysa Karlov is an Orzhov advokist and Grand Envoy who later became head of the Orzhov Syndicate, known for writing and wielding Ravnica's law-magic.

summary.text: Teysa Karlov is an Orzhov advokist and Grand Envoy who later became head of the Orzhov Syndicate, known for writing and wielding Ravnica's law-magic.

bio.text: Bound to obey the Obzedat, including her ghostly grandfather Karlov, she uses a loophole in the Guildpact to challenge their monopoly and breaks into their sanctum with Tajic.
Karlov summons the Obzedat, who revoke her title of advokist and forbid her the practice of law, and she realizes that Grand Envoy was only a way to keep her in debt.
As the newest head of the Orzhov, she hosts the gala at Karlov Manor, reminding her old friend Kaya of her debt and saying she has something important to tell her.
After Zegana is found dead, Teysa writes to Kaya asking her to come alone, and Kaya finds Teysa dead in her parlor with her walking stick through her chest and a note in Phyrexian script.
Oba accuses her of being in league with the Phyrexians, but Etrata reveals Teysa secretly spied on them for the resistance with House Dimir, and Oba is revealed as her killer.
At her funeral her ghost sits beside Kaya, tells her she keeps leading the Syndicate in death, and says she will ruin Selesnya financially rather than use the law.

status.text: Dead, murdered by Oba, but she returns as a ghost and continues to run the Orzhov Syndicate.

timeline.summary: Teysa returns from another day of being yelled at by the Orzhov Ghost Council and reads her old mail by the fire.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov had spent another full day being yelled at by the dead.

timeline.summary: Teysa recalls weeks earlier badgering the Living Guildpact into affirming twenty minor laws until he threw her out.
timeline.quote: After asking him to confirm no less than twenty minor laws and legal requirements

timeline.summary: Teysa resolves to use a loophole created by the Guildpact's new body to challenge the Obzedat's monopoly.
timeline.quote: She could manipulate this technicality to challenge the monopoly of the Obzedat.

timeline.summary: Her ghostly grandfather Karlov appears and lectures her to think of her blood, and she is forced to kiss his ring.
timeline.quote: subserviently kissed the outline of the Councilman's gossamer ring.

timeline.summary: Karlov offers her a coin, and Teysa uses it to buy a knife.
timeline.quote: Teysa used that coin to buy a knife.

timeline.summary: Disguised and shackled, Teysa is led by Tajic through Orzhova to a Boros outpost prison.
timeline.quote: There was a Boros outpost prison near the edge of the main church building.

timeline.summary: In a basement cell Tajic reveals the secret tunnel he carved to the Obzedat's record room, and Teysa explains her law-magic plan.
timeline.quote: All I need to do is directly reference a law affirmed by him and it must be made manifest.

timeline.summary: Teysa recites guild law to open a hidden wall with a warrant and to expose a web of security threads in the records library.
timeline.quote: Small threads appeared in the air, reflecting a web of silvery shimmers in the light of the torch.

timeline.summary: Teysa uses her blood and an article of the Orzhovniha to open the gem-encrusted door of the Obzedat's sanctum.
timeline.quote: The blood was quickly absorbed as a lock deep within the structure released.

timeline.summary: They find the preserved, mummified bodies of the Obzedat on thrones, and Teysa greets her uncle's body.
timeline.quote: Hello, Uncle,

timeline.summary: Teysa pulls up a jeweled chest of records and finds an old Orzhov logbook that Tajic judges to be proof of financial corruption.
timeline.quote: My gut says this is probably the proof you're looking for.

timeline.summary: Teysa invokes the law of exposure, but the logbook becomes immovable and Tajic cannot lift it.
timeline.quote: No matter how hard he tried, he could not pick it up.

timeline.summary: Teysa discovers the Guildpact's law can be broken in the chamber when Tajic easily takes her knife.
timeline.quote: The law can be broken in this room,

timeline.summary: Karlov reveals himself and summons the Obzedat, who rise from the floor.
timeline.quote: Tajic yelled with surprise as dozens of ghosts swiftly rose from beneath the floor.

timeline.summary: Karlov has a thrull take Tajic to the Obzedat dungeon.
timeline.quote: Summon a thrull to escort the Boros to our dungeon,

timeline.summary: The Obzedat revoke Teysa's title of advokist and forbid her the practice of law.
timeline.quote: By order of the Obzedat, your title of advokist is hereby revoked .

timeline.summary: Karlov tells her to come to the tower to discuss her remaining title as Grand Envoy and leaves.
timeline.quote: Don't keep me waiting,

timeline.summary: Alone, Teysa realizes the title of Grand Envoy was only a way to keep her in debt, takes Tajic's sword as a cane and walks toward the stairs.
timeline.quote: The title of Grand Envoy was never a gift. It was a way to keep her bound.

timeline.summary: The Orzhov launch an extravagant fireworks display above Karlov Manor to open the gala.
timeline.quote: The sky over Karlov Manor danced with a dizzying array of colors, brought to life by shimmering cascades of magic.

timeline.summary: Kaya joins Teysa on the manor's highest balcony.
timeline.quote: Soundless as ever, Kaya stepped up next to her, stopping when she reached the rail.

timeline.summary: Teysa reminds Kaya that she owes the Orzhov for not being on Ravnica during the invasion.
timeline.quote: You owe me this night, Kaya.

timeline.summary: Teysa demands that Kaya obey her through the evening.
timeline.quote: So tonight, you smile when I say smile, and you bow when I say bow

timeline.summary: Teysa leads Kaya into the courtyard crowd of Ravnica's elite.
timeline.quote: settling one hand on the taller woman's shoulder in a proprietary fashion

timeline.summary: Teysa explains that Ezrim leads the Agency after the invasion and has drawn away Azorius associates.
timeline.quote: Imagine her displeasure when after the invasion, he took on leadership.

timeline.summary: Tolsimir insists that Lazav is not dead and is planning something.
timeline.quote: It's naive to think that Lazav is dead.

timeline.summary: Teysa addresses the courtyard from the balcony.
timeline.quote: Citizens of Ravnica, welcome to Karlov Manor!

timeline.summary: Teysa celebrates Kaya as a hero of the Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: Tonight, we celebrate Orzhov's own former leader, Kaya, for her role in the salvation of Ravnica and the Multiverse during the Phyrexian invasion

timeline.summary: Teysa announces a tribute to the Agency.
timeline.quote: tonight we honor the members of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations.

timeline.summary: Ezrim honors Kellan, who flees the balcony.
timeline.quote: The Agency thanks you, Ravnica thanks you, and I thank you

timeline.summary: Teysa presses Krenko about the debt he owes the Karlovs.
timeline.quote: Think, Krenko. You owe the Karlovs.

timeline.summary: Aurelia demands the Boros take over the investigation, provoking a scoff from Kellan.
timeline.quote: This investigation should be in the hands of the Boros.

timeline.summary: Teysa finds Kaya alone and says she has something important to tell her.
timeline.quote: There's something I need to tell you. Something important. And I needed to catch you alone.

timeline.summary: A scream from inside the manor interrupts Teysa.
timeline.quote: Teysa started to reply as a scream rang out from inside the manor, drowning out her words and shattering the moment.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Teysa race through the manor toward the scream and find a locked door.
timeline.quote: Kaya ran through the manor as swiftly as her legs could carry her.

timeline.summary: Servers report the door is locked and the key is missing; the door is warded against ghosts.
timeline.quote: The door's locked, ma'am

timeline.summary: At Ezrim's urging, Teysa orders the door broken and it is smashed open.
timeline.quote: Two heavy blows and the door snapped off its hinges, breaking clean in two as it fell inward.

timeline.summary: Kaya enters, gasps, and asks Teysa to send for Vannifar.
timeline.quote: All of them heard Kaya's quickly cut-off gasp, followed by frozen silence.

timeline.summary: Teysa and Kaya find Zegana dead, posed on a pile of coats in the cloakroom.
timeline.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine was artfully arranged at the center of the pile.

timeline.summary: Kaya notices a black iris petal in Zegana's fingers, though none was used in the decor.
timeline.quote: Kaya saw the edges of a flower petal protruding from between Zegana's fingers.

timeline.summary: Teysa informs Vannifar of Zegana's death.
timeline.quote: it is with the deepest of regrets that I inform you that Zegana of the Simic Combine has been killed.

timeline.summary: Azorius mages remove Etrata from Karlov Manor and no Dimir members intervene.
timeline.quote: Etrata's removal from the grounds of Karlov Manor took no time at all in the grand scheme of things.

timeline.summary: Teysa's remark about walking away stirs Kaya's memory of Jace and Vraska.
timeline.quote: Teysa had managed to invoke the shades of Jace and Vraska, the other two people who'd walked away from Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Teysa reports Vannifar is moving from grief to outrage over Zegana's death.
timeline.quote: Vannifar won't allow this to go unanswered.

timeline.summary: Kaya presses Teysa to say what she wanted to tell her; they agree on three days.
timeline.quote: Then, if you haven't called me, I come looking.

timeline.summary: A courier summons Kaya to Karlov Manor with a note from Teysa.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Karlov requests your presence at the manor.

timeline.summary: Teysa's note says it is time for the discussion they couldn't have and asks Kaya to come alone.
timeline.quote: It's time for the discussion we couldn't have during the gala.

timeline.summary: Kaya finds Teysa dead in her private parlor with her walking stick through her chest.
timeline.quote: the shattered shaft of her walking stick protruded from her chest, slick with blood.

timeline.summary: Kaya finds a note in Teysa's handwriting written in Phyrexian script.
timeline.quote: The script was Phyrexian.

timeline.summary: Kaya studies Teysa's body and the scene before the household arrives.
timeline.quote: Teysa's body had yet to cool.

timeline.summary: Kaya calls Teysa's spirit, but only a ghost servant answers that Teysa is not entertaining guests.
timeline.quote: Master Teysa is not entertaining guests at this time

timeline.summary: The ghost reveals Teysa dismissed the living servants in anticipation of Kaya's arrival.
timeline.quote: Master Teysa gave the living servants the day off, in anticipation of your arrival.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Ezrim that Teysa Karlov has been murdered.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov has been murdered.

timeline.summary: Kaya explains she cannot summon Teysa's ghost, who has warded her own soul.
timeline.quote: Teysa will appear when she wants to.

timeline.summary: Tolsimir hints that another guild leader has been harmed and tells Kaya to look within her own guild.
timeline.quote: you might look within your own guild, Planeswalker Kaya.

timeline.summary: Ezrim tells Kaya that Teysa's killer has been caught by the Azorius.
timeline.quote: Teysa's killer has been apprehended by the Azorius.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes the arrest means Teysa is truly gone.
timeline.quote: having a killer means this isn't a trick. Teysa's really gone.

timeline.summary: Kaya arrives at Karlov Cathedral, prepared for Teysa's funeral.
timeline.quote: Kaya's carriage let her off in front of a cathedral dressed to the nines

timeline.summary: Kaya confesses she found a Phyrexian-script note on Teysa's body.
timeline.quote: A note, in her own hand, but not her own language. It was written in Phyrexian.

timeline.summary: Proft lists the victims and the attempt on Aurelia, noting the killers had no memory.
timeline.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine; Teysa of the Orzhov Syndicate; Kylox of the Izzet League.

timeline.summary: Oba claims Teysa was in league with the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov was in league with the Phyrexians, communicating with them in secret.

timeline.summary: Etrata reveals Teysa secretly spied on the Phyrexians for the resistance, working with House Dimir.
timeline.quote: She was working with House Dimir the whole time

timeline.summary: Oba recoils, but Kaya remembers that this face of Trostani is responsible for Teysa's death.
timeline.quote: But this face of Trostani was responsible for Teysa's death

timeline.summary: Three days later Teysa's funeral is held at Karlov Cathedral, and her ghost sits beside Kaya.
timeline.quote: Three days later, Kaya sat in a pew at Karlov Cathedral

timeline.summary: Teysa's ghost tells Kaya she keeps leading the Syndicate in death and that it was she who helped in the fight at Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: Why would a little thing like death stop me from running the Syndicate?

timeline.summary: Teysa explains she will ruin Selesnya financially rather than use the law, and asks Kaya to leave Ravnica.
timeline.quote: You'll have to leave, of course.

timeline.summary: Kaya embraces her friend Teysa, who hugs her back.
timeline.quote: I thought I'd lost you,

relations.quote: The fat, opulent folds of her deceased grandfather, Karlov, ghosted through the closed window of her study.

relations.note: old friends with a tense debt between them
owes a debt to the Karlovs
admits a disagreement over interest rates
relations.quote: This is about my little disagreement with Teysa, then?

relations.note: masterminded the mind-controlled killings of guild leaders
relations.quote: Trostani did this, all of it.

relations.note: Oba murdered Teysa in the aftermath of the invasion.
relations.quote: Murdered by a grief-poisoned Trostani who had been unable to tell friend from foe in the aftermath of the invasion.

relations.note: Teysa is Kaya's friend and her successor in leading the Orzhov.
He was Teysa's second in command.
relations.quote: he served as Teysa's second in command

pages_say.description: A 112-year-old Orzhov Grand Envoy and advokist who writes and wields Ravnica's law-magic and makes a bid to free the Orzhov from the Obzedat.
The matriarch of the Orzhov's leading oligarch family, who stays in her quarters.
The Orzhov leader Tomik Vrona once believed to be the true guildmaster.
The newest head of the Orzhov Syndicate and host of the gala at Karlov Manor, who uses a walking cane.
The head of the Orzhov Syndicate and host of the gala, who orders the locked door broken and locks down the manor.
The head of the Orzhov Syndicate, who asks Kaya to return for a private talk and is found dead with her walking stick through her chest.
The murdered head of the Orzhov, whose body Kaya examines and whose ghost does not appear.
The Orzhov leader whose death is already spreading as news.
The murdered Orzhov leader whom Oba calls a traitor and Etrata calls a hero who spied on the Phyrexians.
The Orzhov guildmaster murdered by Oba, who returns as a ghost, attends her own funeral and continues to run the Syndicate.
The Orzhov leader whose second in command was Tomik.
